description: The chart illustrates the Shapley values for three models, mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM, across various categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Shapley value" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category has a grouped set of three bars, representing the three models, with mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in green. The bars for categories L4+, L2, L1, T, and R1 have relatively higher values, with the bar for category T having the highest value across all models, at approximately 60 for mBERT, 58 for XLM-R, and 78 for chLSTM. The bars for categories L3, R2, R3, and R4+ have lower values, mostly below 5. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the categories are not sorted by value. No bars are visually emphasized.
